headline: Industry sales slipped 0.1% YTD to 5.51M MT
detail: Across Urea, DAP, CAN and NP the industry sold 5,507,897 MT in Jan–Aug 2026 versus 5,512,394 MT a year earlier (-4,497 MT change).

headline: FG off-take -2.2% YTD vs industry -0.1%
detail: FG sold 1,683,927 MT YTD (-38,465 MT vs prior year). Share of industry sales 30.6% (-0.1 pp, published share series); volume-derived 30.6% (-0.7 pp) — the gap is validation rule REC-07.

headline: Urea is FG's biggest gainer: 20,128 MT (+3.0%)
detail: Urea contributes +1.2 pp to FG growth; it is 40% of FG volume.

headline: NP is FG's largest drag: -47,129 MT (-9.8%)
detail: NP subtracts -2.7 pp from total FG growth. FG NP fell from 482,172 to 435,043 MT while industry NP moved -8.9%.

headline: Industry NP moved most: -44,788 MT (-8.9%)
detail: NP is 8% of industry volume (458,804 MT YTD).

headline: Unusual: FG DAP -58% YTD
detail: 44,592 → 18,818 MT. Share of industry DAP fell to 2.7% (-3.7 pp).

headline: Wheat price +46% YoY — verify source
detail: 64.18 → 93.47 PKR/Kg. Movements this large often indicate a unit or sampling change at the source (amis.pk).

headline: Potato (Fresh) price -69% YoY — verify source
detail: 51.19 → 15.8 PKR/Kg. Movements this large often indicate a unit or sampling change at the source (amis.pk).

headline: DAP plan achievement only 28% YTD
detail: Achieved 22,479 MT against a plan of 79,141 MT (gap -56,662 MT).

headline: Data quality score 75/100 — 58 warnings, 0 errors
detail: Top issues: STR-03, STR-04, STR-05, EXT-01, EXT-02, PER-05. Review before relying on the BG/E-BG and Planned-vs-Achieved figures.

headline: FFC gained +3.4 pp of industry share YTD; Engro lost -3.2 pp
detail: Total-fertilizer share YTD: FFC 43.4%, FG 30.6%, Engro 20.6%, AgriTech 3.3%, Imports / Private 2.2%. FG 30.6% (-0.1 pp).

headline: FG DAP share down -3.7 pp to 2.7%
detail: FFC leads with 69.2%; FG ranks #4. Imports / Private +5.0 pp, Engro -1.8 pp.

headline: FG NP share down -0.9 pp to 94.8%
detail: FG leads with 94.8%. Engro +0.9 pp.

headline: FG Nitrogen share 28.3% (+0.2 pp YoY); best zone SOUTH +3.2 pp, weakest NORTH -2.7 pp
detail: Tracked-set basis (FFC + Engro + FG). Zone shares: SOUTH 20.4%, CENTRE 32.5%, NORTH 32.9%.

headline: FG gained +17.2 pp Nitrogen share in Vehari (Multan)
detail: Top gainers: Vehari +17.2 pp, Thatta +16.9 pp, Mirpur Khas +16.3 pp.

headline: Sahiwal recorded the largest YoY Nitrogen share decline (-19.8 pp)
detail: Largest declines: Sahiwal -19.8 pp, Nawabshah -12.5 pp, Abbotabad -12.0 pp (districts above 5,000 MT tracked volume).

headline: FG Phosphate share 44.4% (-2.0 pp YoY); best zone SOUTH +0.6 pp, weakest NORTH -3.8 pp
detail: Tracked-set basis (FFC + Engro + FG). Zone shares: SOUTH 46.6%, CENTRE 44.8%, NORTH 41.7%.

headline: FG gained +22.7 pp Phosphate share in Thatta (Hyderabad)
detail: Top gainers: Thatta +22.7 pp, Tando Allah Yar +21.0 pp, Badin +13.3 pp.

headline: Mandi Baha-Ud-Din recorded the largest YoY Phosphate share decline (-28.5 pp)
detail: Largest declines: Mandi Baha-Ud-Din -28.5 pp, Sukkur -27.5 pp, Sialkot -16.3 pp (districts above 5,000 MT tracked volume).

headline: FG NP retail price +4.2% MoM to PKR 10,453/bag
detail: YoY +21.8%; 13-month range 8,581–10,453. Retail prices across 6 series: Sona Urea +1.7%, Sarsabz Urea +1.7%, Sona DAP +3.7%, Sarsabz DAP +4.1%, FG CAN +0.5%, FG NP +4.2%.

headline: Sarsabz Urea retail is PKR 80 below Sona (-1.7%)
detail: Sarsabz 4,539 vs Sona 4,619 per bag in Aug-26.

headline: Sarsabz Dap retail is PKR 217 below Sona (-1.3%)
detail: Sarsabz 16,419 vs Sona 16,636 per bag in Aug-26.

headline: 1 of 5 crop prices are higher YoY: Wheat +46%
detail: Lower: Seed Cotton -9%, Rice IRRI -1%, Sugar -9%, Potato (Fresh) -69%. Interpretation (not fact): rising crop prices tend to support farmer purchasing power for inputs; falling ones can weigh on it, with a lag.

headline: 11 DAP vessels / 422.7k MT in the pipeline; 180.0k MT yet to arrive
detail: Next arrival: Zhong Chang Hong Sheng (50k MT, Morocco) on 2026-09-27. Quantity-weighted CFR $858/MT. Buyers: Engro 46%, FFC 22%, Other / Private 22%, FG 11%.

headline: DCF order value -24% MoM to PKR 10.3 bn in Aug-26
detail: YTD DCF PKR 82.7 bn across 409 dealers; top bank ALFALAH 30%. E-BG = 88% of BG value (PKR 49.3 bn of 55.8 bn).

headline: What management should watch after August 2026
detail:
1. 180k MT of DAP still to land (140k in transit, 40k upcoming) — FG holds only 11% of it after a -58% FG DAP YTD
2. Sarsabz DAP retail PKR 16,419 (+21% YoY) — check demand elasticity as import cargoes arrive
3. Plan gap: DAP 28%, NP 82% of YTD plan
4. Nitrogen share erosion in Sahiwal (-19.8 pp)
5. News & department updates are stale — refresh them for the next edition
6. Publish the next month to unlock month-on-month industry/FG KPIs (the workbook holds YTD only).
